situation: {@mama} barges into your room holding olive oil: 'My son, your uncle in Canada called! You must sow {$100} seed for the prophet to unlock your travelling star!'

rightChoice.text: Sow the {$100} seed

situation: {@boss} hasn't paid salary for 3 months: 'Boy, be patient, the company is doing a global rebrand! Take this half-bag of rice as bonus.'

rightChoice.text: Humbly collect the rice

situation: {@landlord} is banging on your gate: 'Your annual rent expired yesterday! Pay today or I padlock your door and remove roof!'

leftChoice.text: Pay full rent from travel savings

rightChoice.text: Jump the back fence & squat with friend

situation: Alhaji Bureau texts you at 1 AM: 'Dollar is climbing faster than monkey! If you don't change your {currencyName} tonight, by morning it will buy only biscuits!'

rightChoice.text: Hold your {currencyName} and pray

situation: {@chidi} adjusts dark sunglasses inside {market}: 'My guy, your bank balance is crying. Pay me {$200} and my boy will edit a {$26667} statement with official stamp.'

rightChoice.text: Refuse and use your real statement

situation: {@mama} brings an affidavit: 'Agent says married people get visa faster! I have matched you with your second cousin's friend. Just sign the court paper!'

rightChoice.text: Reject: 'Mama I cannot marry stranger!'

situation: Uncle Emma sends a WhatsApp voice note from London: 'If you want invitation letter from me, send £500 Western Union first. London is not cheap oh!'

rightChoice.text: Tell Uncle Emma he is stingy

situation: {@chidi} calls frantically: 'Embassy changed rules! They need medical report showing you had yellow fever vaccine in 1994. Pay {$35} express lab fee?'

leftChoice.text: Pay for the express fake yellow card

rightChoice.text: Go stand in government hospital queue

situation: Prophet Gabriel is holding vigil outside {embassyGate} at 3:30 AM: 'Pour this consecrated olive oil inside your shoe so every officer will show you favor!'

leftChoice.text: Pour oil in your brand new shoes

rightChoice.text: Politely decline and stay focused

situation: The gate bouncer stops you: 'Oga, your phone and big envelope cannot enter the compound. Keep them in my plastic bucket for {$3} security fee.'

leftChoice.text: Pay and hand over your phone

rightChoice.text: Argue that it's extortion!

situation: {@mama} calls as you enter the security scanner: 'Are you wearing the white handkerchief the prayer team washed with holy water?! Answer me now!'

rightChoice.text: Cut the call and switch phone off

situation: Consul Smith glares through bulletproof glass: 'You claim to be attending a 3-day conference on Sustainable Artificial Intelligence. What is an algorithm?'

leftChoice.text: 'It is the spiritual pathway to success, sir!'

rightChoice.text: Recite Wikipedia definition word-for-word

situation: Consul Smith inspects your {$8000} bank statement: 'Your account received a single bulk deposit of {$7933} three days before this appointment. Can you explain?'

leftChoice.text: 'It was inheritance from my late royal uncle.'

rightChoice.text: Hand him an additional affidavit of explanation

situation: Consul Smith leans forward: 'You are 26, single, and have no landed property. What guarantees you will return to your home country after 2 weeks?'

rightChoice.text: Show photos of your mother and 3 family shops

situation: {@customs} opens your luggage at {airport}: 'Ah! 6 tubers of yam, 4 bottles of red palm oil, and 2kg of dried crayfish! Oga, this requires custom clearing beverage.'

rightChoice.text: Let him confiscate the crayfish and yam

situation: Flight is boarding at gate 12. {@mama} sends 47 WhatsApp pictures of family prayer warriors on their knees: 'Send {$35} for their departure transport now!'

rightChoice.text: Airplane Mode activated immediately!

situation: Transit in Istanbul. The airline counter says your ticket was booked through a fraudulent third party! Pay $200 rebooking fee right now or get stranded?

rightChoice.text: Shout and quote passenger bill of rights

situation: Frau Helga knocks at 9:00 PM: 'Why is heating set to 24°C?! In this house we wear two sweaters and keep radiator at 17°C! Pay €80 energy surcharge!'

leftChoice.text: Pay the €80 and keep the radiator hot

rightChoice.text: Turn off radiator and sleep in 4 puffer jackets

situation: Uncle Emma visits your cold bunkbed: 'My boy, you have arrived! Now remember: the family back home is expecting $800 monthly remittance starting next Friday.'

leftChoice.text: Take night shift warehouse job immediately

rightChoice.text: 'Uncle, I haven't even found my feet yet!'

situation: Smoke detector goes off because your roommate is frying pepper and stockfish at 11 PM! Police sirens echo in the quiet European street!

leftChoice.text: Open windows into the freezing -5°C snow storm

rightChoice.text: Cover smoke alarm with plastic shopping bag

situation: {@njangi} hands you the njangi pot in a black plastic bag: {$800} cash. Your mother already announced it in church before you even counted it.

leftChoice.text: Put every franc in the japa fund

rightChoice.text: Share it with the family

situation: {@bendskin} drops you in Akwa and philosophises: 'Grand, bush is not easy. My cousin in Paris sweeps the metro at night. Me, I make {$5} a day and I am happy.' Then he charges triple fare.

rightChoice.text: Argue the fare in pure Camfranglais

situation: {@feyman} straightens his shiny suit: 'For {$500} I get you a French work contract from a vineyard. Signed by the mayor of Bordeaux himself, I swear on my mother.'

rightChoice.text: Walk away from the 'opportunity'

situation: {@gendarme} stops your bendskin at a checkpoint: 'Papiers! Your national ID expired last week. Ça va faire {$5} for my coffee.'

rightChoice.text: Insist on going to the commissariat

situation: 4 AM at {embassyGate}. {@njangi} is here too, selling queue places at {$15} each. Behind you, a man is reading Psalms loudly in French and Pidgin.

leftChoice.text: Buy a place near the front

rightChoice.text: Hold your place and join the Psalms

situation: Consul Smith frowns: 'Your form says profession: "call-box operator and ndolé consultant". Please explain.'

leftChoice.text: 'Sir, ndolé is our national dish. I consult!'

rightChoice.text: Show your call-box receipt notebook

situation: At {airport}, your aunt's 5kg of njansang, dried bitter leaf and one whole smoked fish set off the scanner. {@customs} smiles: 'Massa, this one is export without licence.'

rightChoice.text: Let him keep the smoked fish

situation: {@cousin_paris} calls from Château-Rouge: 'They are asking at home why you have not sent Western Union. I told them you are a big Bush Faller now, with office job.'

leftChoice.text: Send {$100} home to protect the legend

rightChoice.text: Tell the truth: you wash plates

situation: Dumsor again! {@ecg} says the transformer needs a 'contribution' of {$20} per house before light comes back. Your laptop with the visa application is on 3%.

rightChoice.text: Charge your laptop at the chop bar

situation: {@sakawa} pulls up at the trotro station in a Benz: 'Chale, why japa? Come work for me. You just chat with lonely oyibo on Facebook. {$500} a week.'

rightChoice.text: Just one week...

situation: {@makola} leans over her tomatoes at Makola: 'My nephew works at the passport office. Give me {$100} and your passport will be ready by Friday, not next year.'

rightChoice.text: Wait for the official process

situation: {@trotro} shouts 'Circle! Circle!' and hands you a flyer: 'GUARANTEED CANADA VISA. 100% PASS. NO IELTS. Call Prophet-Agent Kwesi.' The trotro is too packed to argue.

rightChoice.text: Use the flyer to fan yourself

situation: 5 AM at {embassyGate}. Everybody is in suit and tie. {@makola} has set up a stall selling 'interview-ready' kente ties for {$20}.

rightChoice.text: Go in your plain shirt

situation: Consul Smith reads your sponsor letter: 'Uncle Fiifi Enterprises, East Legon. What exactly does this company do?'

rightChoice.text: Show Uncle Fiifi's fresh tax returns

situation: At {airport}, your Ghana-Must-Go bag weighs 31kg: shito, gari, kenkey and two frozen tilapia. The check-in agent says it's {$15} per extra kilo.

rightChoice.text: Eat three balls of kenkey at the counter

situation: {@cousin_london}: 'Charley, welcome to abrokyire! Rule one: never tell anyone at home it is cold. Rule two: send money for my sister's wedding.'

rightChoice.text: Post a 'living my best life' photo instead
